title: First-touch launchpad: hero, journey tiles, and staged screenshot runbook
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Deliver a cohesive hero module, a set of 3 responsive journey tiles, and a staged screenshot runbook that can be used in the Quickstart landing page for the upcoming console-2026.03 release. This ticket owns visual direction, final mocks at desktop/tablet/mobile, asset exports, and the screenshot capture instructions for engineering/QA.

Scope:
- Hero: headline, 3-step micro-illustration (abbreviated), supporting subcopy, CTA states (primary/secondary), and a lightweight animation spec for Lottie or CSS micro-interaction.
- Journey tiles: three entryways (Start, Integrate, Ship) with variant states (default/hover/focus/disabled) and optional per-tile microcopy for enterprise vs. self-serve personas.
- Staged screenshots runbook: canonical viewports, copy overlays, user flows to capture, masking rules for PII, and automated capture pipeline notes (Percy + CI).

Constraints:
- Follow design-system tokens; avoid introducing new typography scales.
- All hero color contrasts must meet AA for 16px body copy.
- Illustrations must be consistent with existing 'friendly technical' tone but avoid previous bright-illustration palette used on older quickstart pages.

Deliverables:
- Figma frames: Hero (desktop/tablet/mobile), Tile variants, Animation frames, and export-ready slices.
- PNG/SVG assets exported into the release-assets folder with naming convention DS-hero-v1-<breakpoint>.svg/png.
- Runbook.md (short) with screenshot commands, viewport list, and an SVG overlay template for product team to apply before automated snapshots.
acceptance_criteria: Hero comps added to Figma with responsive frames for 1440/1024/375
Journey tiles have accessible focus/hover states and spec tokens in comments
Illustration set exported (SVG) and approved by Brand
Screenshot runbook includes Percy config sample and masking rules
PRD link and final assets attached to the Linear ticket
milestones: 03-12: final assets and runbook ready for handoff
comments: 2026-03-02 - Avery Chen: Uploaded initial toneboard and 3 hero directions. Direction A emphasizes kinetic device mockups; Direction B emphasizes simplified illustrations. Requesting PM preference before proceeding.
2026-03-04 - Priya Nair (PM): Prefer Direction B for faster localization and smaller asset size. Also prefer tiles copy to be 1 line max. Marking blocked for final copy from docs team.

2026-03-06 - Riley Martinez: Mid-fidelity uploaded — hero uses brand-gradient-2 with muted illustration colors. Added accessibility notes about contrast and focus ring. Requesting engineering input on animation performance (want sub-50ms main-thread impact).

2026-03-09 - Jordan Lee (Eng): Reviewed animation spec; recommend using CSS transforms and will offload to compositor. Suggested removing heavy SVG filters; engineering to prototype in staging-UI. Added ENG-7201 as dependency for front-end timing budget.
2026-03-10 - Brand (Lena K.): Illustration set needs one color adjustment: swap accent-3 to brand-500 for consistency with hero CTA. Approve after change.

2026-03-12 - Riley Martinez: Final assets exported and uploaded to release-assets. Created runbook snippet for Percy; included masking rules and viewport list. Leaving for QA and Percy pipeline wiring.

2026-03-12 - QA (Samir Patel): Noted screenshot flakiness with animated micro-interactions. Recommend capturing static hero frame for automated tests and keeping animation for production only. Added to engineering follow-up.
2026-03-12 - Avery Chen: Updated runbook to instruct automated captures to use the "static" frame and to schedule a visual review before enabling animation snapshots.
screenshot_pipeline_notes: Capture steps: 1) Seed test org with sample project data; 2) Use viewports: 1440x900, 1024x768, 375x812; 3) Apply SVG overlay template for copy; 4) Mask any API keys or user identifiers; 5) Run Percy job with static-frame parameter to avoid animation flakiness. Example Percy cmd included in Figma comments.
accessibility_notes: All images must include descriptive alt text in CMS; hero CTAs must meet 4.5:1 contrast for text and 3:1 for large display copy. Focus ring token applied for keyboard nav; tile hover should also show visible focus state. Provide WCAG checklist in handoff.
notes_for_engineering: Eng team to prototype CSS-based hero animation using will-change and transform properties; avoid SVG filters. Provide a lightweight placeholder for low-bandwidth devices. Engineering ticket ENG-7201 to include timing budget and perf test. Coordinate on export path for assets (release-assets/quickstart/hero/).
